title: Seein’ Double
description: Look it’s Jody. No it’s Judy! Teenage identical twins are double duty! Jody’s a prankster, Judy’s a bookworm, and they’re both a handful for their father, Henry Bumpter.
quote: We can’t just ignore this thing and hope it’ll disappear like Jimmy Hoffa, Amelia Earhart, Judge Crater, and the comedy team of Wayne and Shuster.
altHero: Stephanie Vanderkellen as twins Jody and Judy, each in a sweater with their names on them
alt1: Dick Loudon as Henry Bumpter, looking through a hole cut out of his newspaper
alt2: Jody and Judy, who has her face covered with a big book
alt3: Jody and Judy baking in the kitchen, Judy is facing away from the camera, and Jody is holding two similar boxes: one is flour and the other is detergent
alt4: Henry hugging the twins, along with neighbors Smitty and Iron
